prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in League City, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1156; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Good afternoon. This recorded statement is regarding the sideswipe incident you reported. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state the location where the accident occurred.

A: It was on the frontage road near the intersection in League City, Texas, heading toward the shopping center.

Q: Thank you. Can you tell me what you were doing right before the collision?

A: I was changing lanes to the right because I needed to get over for the exit. I checked my mirror and didn't see anything, so I signaled and started moving over.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle at any point before contact?

A: Not until it was right beside me. There was a loud scraping sound and my car got pushed toward the curb.

Q: How fast do you estimate you were traveling?

A: Maybe thirty-five or so. Traffic was moving steadily.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you have any injuries at the scene?

A: I felt fine at first, just shaken up. But by the next morning my neck was stiff and the pain went into my shoulders. Now I have headaches and turning my head to the left hurts a lot.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care and they diagnosed whiplash. I've been going to physical therapy twice a week since then.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get my car repaired and get better.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.

A: Thank you.
